newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Probe says delays to oil restart.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Probe says delays to oil restart.

text.p: The restart of production from the Mokhtikovskoye oil field in Western Siberia has been delayed due to late delivery of newly-purchased steam generation equipment, Probe Resources NL said on Wednesday.
The equipment is required to correct a pipeline plugging problem that has caused production to be shut in since December 20, 1996, Probe said.
Delivery of the equipment is now expected by January 31 and production startup should occur within several to 10 days of delivery, Probe said.

Probe holds a 50 percent interst in the Mokhtikovskye, which has current proven recoverable reserves of 26.5 million barrels, proven and probable recoverable reserves of 47.86 million barrels and proven, probable and possible reserves totalling just under 70 million barrels.
The other 50 percent interest is sheld by Siboil of Russia, which also is the operator.

Probe relisted on the Australian Stock Exchange late last year after acquiring its stake in Mokhtikovskye. At the time, Probe said the field was producing from its first six wells at a higher-than-expected 1,500 barrels a day.
